newsitem.title: JAPAN: Stable currencies important for Japan economy -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Stable currencies important for Japan economy -- MOF.

text.p: Stable currency rates are important for Japan to achieve a sustainable economic recovery, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a parliamentary committee on Monday.
"Stability of currency rates...will contribute to a self-sustainable economic recovery," he said, adding that as the finance minister, he will do his utmost to achieve stability in exchange rates.
The dollar tumbled nearly 2.5 yen from the New York Friday close to 111.80 yen in Tokyo on Monday, the lowest level since November 25, 1996.
